skill.name: higgsfield-brandkit
skill.description: Create and extend complete visual brand systems through the Higgsfield CLI and bundled deterministic local tooling: palettes, SVG logo marks, typography, mockups, social graphics, packaging, signage, merchandise, posters, presentation decks, and editable PPTX/PDF brandbooks. Preserves official supplied assets, persists approvals locally, and regenerates only dependent outputs. Use when: "create a brand kit", "make a visual identity", "design a logo and brandbook", "apply this logo to branded assets", "make packaging or signage", or "extend our existing branding". Chain with higgsfield-generate for general image production and Marketing Studio brand-kits when importing website metadata for ads. NOT for unbranded image generation (use higgsfield-generate), product catalog photography (use higgsfield-product-photoshoot), website implementation (use higgsfield-websites), or native Figma/Canva/PSD/AI delivery.
skill.summary: Create coherent visual identities, approved brand assets, and editable brandbooks with Higgsfield and local deterministic tools.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, OOXML paths, file signatures, and guarded subprocess use. Confirmed risks include pipe-to-shell installation, privileged package commands, remote downloads, mutable template processing, and unbounded PPTX decompression. Publication should wait until the critical installation guidance is replaced.

remediation.issue: The bootstrap executes a mutable remote installer directly through sh.
remediation.suggestion: Use a versioned release artifact, publish its checksum, verify it locally, and request confirmation before executing the downloaded file.

remediation.issue: Setup guidance includes root-level package installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Keep sudo commands user-operated, explain each package, and never run them automatically from the skill.

remediation.issue: The canonical PPTX is mutable remote content processed by LibreOffice.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a template version and SHA-256 digest, verify the bytes before parsing, and reject any mismatch.

remediation.issue: PPTX archive entries are expanded into memory without uncompressed limits.
remediation.suggestion: Reject excessive entry counts, suspicious compression ratios, oversized entries, and excessive total uncompressed size before reading entries.

content.value_statement: Brand creation often produces inconsistent assets and unclear approvals. This skill coordinates identity design, review stages, deterministic exports, and editable brandbooks.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes supplied logos, colors, fonts, references, and requested deliverables.
Maintains local approval state for palettes, logos, typography, and downstream assets.
Creates palette reviews, SVG logo candidates, typography pairings, and Brand Lock constraints.
Exports approved logos as geometry-preserving SVG and 2048-pixel PNG variants.
Produces mockups, social graphics, packaging, signage, merchandise, posters, and presentation assets.
Builds editable PPTX brandbooks and verified PDF versions from an approved template.
limitations: Higgsfield generation requires an authenticated workspace and network access.
Some exports require ImageMagick, librsvg, LibreOffice, Poppler, Fontconfig, Node.js, or Playwright.
The skill does not deliver native Figma, Canva, PSD, AI, or EPS files.
Interactive identity work requires explicit approval before final logo and foundation choices.

use_cases.title: Launch a new identity
use_cases.description: Develop a palette, logo direction, typography system, and brand guidelines through staged approvals.

use_cases.title: Extend an existing brand
use_cases.description: Apply approved assets to packaging, signage, merchandise, social graphics, and presentations without redesigning the core identity.

use_cases.title: Standardize campaign production
use_cases.description: Create consistent campaign assets and editable brand documentation from a shared Brand Lock.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic brand kit
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a brand kit for [brand name]. The audience is [audience], and the desired character is [traits].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin a new visual identity with a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Apply an existing identity
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supplied official logo, colors, and fonts. Create [deliverables] while preserving every approved brand element.
prompt_templates.scenario: Extend a complete identity without redesigning it.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a partial identity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these existing brand assets. Identify only the missing elements required for [deliverable], then create those elements through approval stages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Fill specific gaps in an established brand system.

prompt_templates.title: Build a full brandbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an editable PPTX and matching PDF brandbook for [brand]. Include approved identity foundations, usage rules, and [mockup types].
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce advanced documentation after foundation approvals.

output_examples.input: Create a visual identity for Northline, a modern logistics platform serving regional manufacturers.
output: Three palette review options with editable HTML and PNG previews.
Three distinct SVG symbol candidates for explicit selection.
Approved typography pairings and a concise Brand Lock summary.

output_examples.input: Apply our approved logo and colors to retail packaging and storefront signage.
output: Packaging and signage previews using the supplied official assets.
Stable variant names for focused revisions.
Editable and flattened format labels with production limitations.

output_examples.input: Build final brand guidelines from our approved logo, palette, typography, and mockups.
output_examples.output: An editable PPTX brandbook, a verified matching PDF, and a concise font installation warning when required.

best_practices: Provide official assets, exact brand spelling, required copy, and requested formats at the start.
Approve palette, logo, and typography choices explicitly before requesting dependent outputs.
Keep the generated state file with the project so revisions preserve prior approvals.
anti_patterns: Do not request a redesigned logo when supplied official artwork must remain unchanged.
Do not provide unverified claims, prices, certifications, ingredients, or regulatory text.
Do not expect native Figma, Canva, PSD, AI, or EPS deliverables.

faq.question: Can this skill use my existing logo?
faq.answer: Yes. It can lock supplied official assets and apply them without redesigning their geometry.

faq.question: Does it create new logos?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates three SVG symbol directions and waits for explicit selection before approval.

faq.question: What brandbook formats are available?
faq.answer: It produces an editable PPTX and a matching verified PDF from the canonical template.

faq.question: Does it require Higgsfield access?
faq.answer: Yes for generated imagery and logo candidates. Local state, previews, exports, and document assembly also require listed system tools.

faq.question: Can it deliver Figma or Adobe source files?
faq.answer: No. It does not produce native Figma, Canva, PSD, AI, or EPS files.

faq.question: How are revisions managed?
faq.answer: Approvals are stored locally. Changing a foundation element invalidates only dependent outputs that use that element.
